retained_cases.required_proof: Reconstruct a basin before deposition, after burial/uplift and after erosion, including arbitrary interior instants. Query in reverse order and after restart; formations, exposed materials and known facts agree.

Realize opposite sides of a plate boundary, watershed divide and river outlet in different orders/worker counts. Verify equal shared contracts, finite dependency discovery and no retrospective river/ore movement from loading.

Erode and transport a mineral-bearing formation, redeposit it, excavate both eras and attempt cross-branch transfer. Account for remaining reservoirs, transformed quantities and duplicate claims through crash/retry.

Apply earthquake displacement or volcanic deposition to lived terrain containing a mine, occupied stacked town, ship and held encounter. Verify complete support/hazard/custody consequences, finite work and ordinary NPC responses.

Compare gradual migration, avulsion, a dam and subsidence. Preserve distinct land/water states, sediment budgets, old channels and submerged structures; update real navigation/trade rather than only artwork.

Prepare large geological intervals and several active regions while normal play continues. Measure storage growth, preparation latency, backlog recovery and knowledge-safe forecasts; human review assesses whether change creates meaningful play rather than routine destruction.

Walk from an inhabited surface site into upper dry caves, a lower flooded passage and a deep settlement; cross a separate shadow portal. Verify distinct Z/realm ownership, clearance, resident identity and persistence.

Apply one disturbance to declared supports/conduits while remote rain adds accounted recharge. Repeat across chunk order, restart and concurrent excavation; preserve water/debris, valid routes and unchanged unaffected passages.

Breach an occupied compartment with different breathing capabilities, cargo and a powered pump while another player holds combat. Resolve admission, exposure, evacuation, repair and recovery without free air, duplicated goods or hidden damage.

Accumulate/ablate ice over recorded terrain, move sediment, impound and release a lake, then visit previously unprepared intermediate instants. Preserve irreversible erosion/deposition, reservoirs and exact-time identity across compaction/restart.

Revisit one coastal settlement before and after water-level/land-elevation changes. Preserve structures, legitimate population/lifecycle transitions, cargo and ownership; validate changed routes and possible recovery without substituting an era prefab.

Interrupt a cave nutrient input and compare aquatic/cave inhabitants' feasible responses. Humans inspect actual dry/wet/icy native scenes, repeated motions, depth clarity and meaningful travel/care choices; agents retain observed inputs/state, not imagined playtests.

Run communicating vessels, stacked basins, pumps and three converging cross-chunk inflows, including unlike liquids. Vary worker/load order and crash mid-commit. Quantities, residuals, capacity, reactions and resumed flow must agree; duplication, disappearance or order-dependent outcomes fail.

Water partially cools a lava channel; crust remains hazardous until its declared thermal state permits crossing. Freeze/melt a loaded crossing and drift a floe against a ship; compare a glacier's distinct process. Verify conserved phases, support/nav consequences and interruption under Wait.

Grow annual crops, perennial tea and wild herbs through rain, drought, frost, grazing and partial harvest. Revisit after coarse scheduling, rest interruption and restart. Yields, seed viability and regrowth match accounting; human playtests assess forecasts, native readability and care burden.

Realize the same forest edge and dryland in reversed chunk/history-query order. Apply clearing, seed transport, drought, overgrazing and restoration; inspect arbitrary interior dates. Cohorts, named plants, soil/sediment and derived labels remain consistent without invented seed sources or label flicker.

A neutral grazer feeds, a predator chooses between prey and risk, and a parent defends offspring. Change hunger, injury and local knowledge; move the group between detailed/coarse simulation. Consumption, deaths, migration and bounded offspring traits remain causal, persistent and reproducible.

Corrupt a healthy forest upstream of farms and a town with four separated players. Trace contaminated water/food, displaced wildlife, NPC responses, containment and partial recovery across held encounters, unload/reload and historical forks. Native scenes must communicate actionable changes without visual overload or unavoidable maintenance spam.

Traverse town, wilderness and dungeon through day/night/weather changes, brief battles, long Wait and dialogue interruptions. Record the cue/transition trace and native output. Check phrase continuity, no clicks/storms of restarts, intelligible effects and human acceptance of both epic and mundane pacing.

Follow original coastal birds, a specific creature, roof rain and cave drips across stacked rooms, a breached wall and submersion. Verify source/medium/topology changes, local population allowance, captions and secrecy. Muted audio must preserve authoritative NPC hearing consequences.

Run four separated players, one held encounter, a shared performance, reconnect, scene streaming and historical travel. Verify no gameplay advancement from audio transport, no expired one-shot replay or private-story leakage, correct context recovery and bounded playback drift.

Play long native sessions with dense weather/crowds/vehicles, cozy crafting/exploration, routine combat and a rare warranted climax on representative desktop and later mobile hardware. Audit acoustic-intent mappings and contextual voice limits; capture memory/streaming/underrun evidence. Compare headphones, speakers, mono and reduced dynamics. Humans assess fatigue, repeated songs/phrases, gentle fades, restraint, atmosphere and accessibility.

Across supported biome, season and starting-role profiles, retain an actual observe/practice/independent-use/combination sequence with actors, stock, permission, costs, time and recovery witnesses. Include shared-consumable and shop-closing counterexamples. Native novice sessions must demonstrate understanding in a changed task; solver success and tutorial completion alone do not pass.

Ignore, skip and re-enable help; complete the initial problem through a supported alternative; change character and input device. Verify actual rewards and consequences, no unearned powers or knowledge, and a later opportunity to practice the bypassed mechanic. Test readable controller and accessible explanations without compulsory timed input.

Four players with different familiarity and character knowledge cooperate, separate, reconnect and hand off control during teaching, rest and an encounter. Verify personal guidance, correct action/learning credit, scoped information, ordinary clock rules and no party-wide forced tutorial. Retain human observations of interruption and clutter.

Interrupt a lesson through mentor death/departure, flooding, resource consumption, season change and a historical branch. Retain truthful invalidation and feasible rebinding or stated unavailability, without replacement identities or free supplies. Repeat during later multi-system coordination; verify current actionable summaries, bounded prompt queues and understandable exceptions in extended native sessions.
Fixed-parent bounded inheritance across retry/worker/query order without unsupported morphology.
Grazing, depletion, predation, remains and recovery with accounted stocks and no camera refill.
Valid contextual onboarding after lost teacher/resource and independent co-op readiness.
Save/crash/branch continuation plus stale-target and duplicate-action failures.
feed the same authoritative fluid observations to GPU effects enabled/disabled and different graphics backends; world receipts, water and hazard outcomes remain identical.
exercise rotating/height-channel puzzles with disconnected loops, unloaded seams, depleted sources and unpowered uphill ports; connectivity success never creates water or power.
two animals target one berry across pruning, coarse/detail transitions, Wait and reload; one consumption, valid targets and no duplicated seed/credit survive.
repeat seasonal care at varied frame cadence, reduced motion, unloaded intervals and historical reconstruction; compare canonical ecology, exposure and receipt state.

realize a capability graph spatially, then remove a bridge/tool or change permissions; retain a valid witness or report truthful changed reachability, and reproduce every flagged encounter from saved inputs.
exhaust tiny-board and multi-wrap puzzle neighborhoods, overcapacity placement and mixed mine values; record seeded layouts and a valid solution/deduction contract.

A supported start includes two cultural varieties, a different script and a specialized cant. Player and NPC comprehension differ. Demonstrate ordinary trade, shelter and known-hazard communication through real accessible means; removing an interpreter triggers an honest alternative or stated limitation, not universal hidden fluency.

Four players inspect the same inscription and overhear a conversation with different actor knowledge. Retain hypotheses, legitimate translation, deception and repeat inspection; no secret truth or language learning leaks through packets, localization, captions or tooltips. Optional deciphering can be bypassed through a valid alternative without invalidating the world.

Compare long ordinary play, interrupted sleep acceleration, distant batching, held encounters and historical transit. Retain equivalent owned biological exposure, stable birth identities and no destination-date aging or catch-up. Human sessions assess natural-loss frequency; pre-existing families and near-due events demonstrate lifecycle depth without forced generational speedup.

Kill a real actor once across retry/restart, with an unseen witness and an applicable spirit outcome. Verify remains, estate, office and care transitions; one person/form authority; only supported spirit senses/actions; distinct legal presumption and observer belief; no secret death confirmation or free inventory/scouting.

Resolve an eligible haunting through different supported traditions and delegated jobs, including inaccessible remains and a flooded grave. Preserve costs, memories and completed obligations; repeated entry/reload cannot duplicate spirits or demands. Extended settlement sessions must show optional atmospheric depth without universal recurring memorial chores.

Two casters, a divine intervention and a realm return contend for the same deceased person after inheritance and office succession. Under Wait, branch travel and crash recovery, commit one valid return with paid costs and reconciled body/spirit/custody; retain social consequences and prevent duplicate property, bodies, powers or export rights.

Generate and inhabit settlements from two distinct cultural traditions under comparable terrain/resource conditions, plus variants within each tradition. Demonstrate differences in street/courtyard access, gathering, workshop organization and a real craft process, with working supplies, labor, drainage, support and routes. Native play must recognize useful distinctions without excess clutter or confusing essential services; no compulsory species/nation style or facade-only pass.

Move a craftsperson and household between cultures, change civic or religious affiliation, teach a supported technique and construct/repair a hybrid workshop. Retain individual knowledge/preferences, actual costs, old building layers and material provenance across restart and historical branches. Allegiance changes cannot instantly replace architecture, recipes, language or personality; hybridization must come from recorded learning and work.

Adjacent catchments with unequal upstream distances, seasonal depth and a newly closed dam retain coherent divides, conserved flow and actual caravan/boat route consequences across load/Wait/history order

Constrained pipe/building patterns and a large exploration loop terminate within declared budgets, preserve accepted boundaries and expose a reproducible rejection rather than hiding an order-dependent repair

Deliver the needed food or resolve the threatening relationship between quest offer and acceptance; update or retire the actual request without fabricated need, duplicated reward or deleted legitimate obligation

Sample unfamiliar starting regions and later campaigns for several attainable challenge types, modest early demands and broad late combinations; reject misleading difficulty witnesses and measure actual player choice/understanding
